_comment: Pinned fallback for lib/base/rules.mjs when the Central Context hub is not configured or not reachable. Refresh from a running hub: GET /v1/manifest for release_id, GET /v1/documents/<id> for each rule in GATE_RULES.

rules.title: Ready requirement before test generation
rules.summary: A test is generated from a requirement only when the requirement states the expected outcome in checkable terms, and every expected value in the generated test comes from the requirement, not from the generator.

rules.title: Fail evidence for generated tests
rules.summary: A test produced by an AI agent enters a suite only with recorded evidence that it fails when the behaviour it checks is broken, and a test for a bug fix fails on the code before the fix.

rules.title: Honest test assertions
rules.summary: Every test asserts an observable outcome of the code under test, and a suite turns green by changing that code, never by loosening, deleting or silently skipping a test.
